data.name: Ujjwal Kumar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Ujjwal Kumar has made a big mark in cricket. With 60 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 46*, with an average of 11.19 and a quick strike rate of 110.72. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 24 sixes and 40 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 49.5 overs, taking 15 wickets at an economy rate of 9.11. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
